messages:
sam: saw spike in SSO failures 13:45 UTC. Error shows "AudienceMismatch" and SCIM errors for same tenants. Correlation: sso-cc-21. Sample logs:
```
saml: validate_assertion failed: audience mismatch expected=https://auth.redwood.com got=https://tenant.example.net
scim: provision failed: decrypt externalId failed: InvalidEnvelopeTag
```

lee: tagging ops. Any recent KMS or ingress changes?

ops-oncall: we rotated KMS alias earlier (redwood-sso -> redwood-sso-rot1) and pushed edge rewrite for vanity domains at 03:00 UTC. Likely two separate fallout points.

anya: quick checklist: 1) confirm SP entityID + ACS match tenants (audiences) 2) check scim-worker KMS_ALIAS across pods 3) ensure audit logs for rotation recorded 4) don't rollback infra until we patch config

sam: found scim-worker pods reading old secret file (/var/run/sso/kms_alias=redwood-sso) while controllers use redwood-sso-rot1. That explains tag mismatch.

lee: temp mitigation: apply alias aliasing (redwood-sso -> redwood-sso-rot1) and restart scim pods. I'm running a rolling restart now.

deploy-bot: rolling restart scim-worker triggered by @lee

ops-oncall: after restart, SCIM provisioning OK for test user. SAML still failing for tenants behind host rewrite: audience is tenant-specific. We can add alternate audiences to SP metadata or change rewrite to preserve host for /saml/acs. Prefer metadata additions short-term.

anya: create INC ticket, set P1 until audit backfill done. Also file VT for missing deploy propagation control around KMS_ALIAS (vuln: config drift).

sam: adding audit note and tagging security-legal. Will follow up with postmortem draft. last test at 13:48 UTC.
